decisive_items: diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
HMB45 and Melan A were negative
CD117, DOG1, cytokeratin, CD34, smooth muscle actin, desmin, chromogranin, and CD56 were all negative
response.rationale: Strong S100/SOX10 positivity with negative melanocytic markers (HMB45/Melan A) and negative GIST markers (CD117/DOG1) favors MPNST over clear cell sarcoma and GIST.

rejected.why: CD117 and DOG1 are negative, contradicting GIST diagnosis.
HMB45 and Melan A are negative, excluding clear cell sarcoma despite nested clear-cell morphology.
